author: Robin_DD_J
body:
I was thinking of a "Tie breaker" for the tournament, and came up with this.

Both team's spawn in their spawn rooms, and the first team to reach, and destory the monument on their side wins! The other team will be able to shot down the enemy team. You got "one" piece of stained glass which will allow you to build up walls, I've added this to not make the map go in a forever loop.  

But I'd just like every's opinion on this for now! 


And yes I know, it's probably more simple than 1+1
